title: Boxborough 2-17-2001 Director's Report
author: Kris Earle
event_desc: a constructed tournament in Boxborough, Massachusetts, run by Kris Earle
summary: Tournament director Kris Earle reported that 14 players took part in the Jabba's Palace sealed event and 32 in the constructed event at Boxborough, Massachusetts, on 17 February 2001.
notes: Director's report only: player counts, no results (winners promised later).
Byline 'Kris "Figgiedan" Earle', signed 'Figgiedan, RED 110' (Squadron Member Red 110, matching [[Kris Earle]]).
Event names shared with d1742 and d1749 (Hayes Hunter won the constructed event, Michael Schiemer the sealed, per those reports; not stated here).

side_events.summary: 14 players took part in the Jabba's Palace sealed event.
